name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; no address residue. It is the central per-frame game event/input dispatcher invoked from main's run loop. Strictly the per-frame loop body rather than a loop itself (the loop lives in main), so 'main_loop' is slightly imprecise, but it is an established, non-misleading domain name that correctly conveys 'the per-frame driver that runs the game'. Not worth a wide-impact rename for that nuance.
purpose: Per-frame game event/input handler: reads one keyboard scancode and dispatches field/map and in-battle input (next-actor, action/confirm, status, tactical zoom, cursor movement).
logic_summary: Reads a scancode via fd2_wait_for_input_with_idle, then a big if/else dispatch. ESC-like (0x01/0x2C/0x4C): iterate party from current_active_char_idx, pan cursor to the next selectable player (flags&0x85==0 and team==2), advance current_active_char_idx (wrap at party_member_count), clear keyboard, return 0. Space/Enter (0x39/0x1C): decrement click_debounce_skip_count if >0 else spin-wait for chapter_init_done_flag; fd2_find_char_at_cursor_pos -> if none, loop fd2_field_command_menu_loop until non-zero, map 1->0, return it (the only non-zero-returning path); if a char is found, zero pending_xp_credit and (unless portrait_id==0x79 or archetype_flag==10) either run fd2_player_action_menu_loop (alive selectable player) or fd2_open_char_status_screen, then composite frame, clamp pending_xp_credit to 99, process XP/level-up, dispatch per-chapter post-action handler[current_chapter_id], check all-acted, run AI post-action consequence handler if idx!=0xFF (reset to 0xFF), clear keyboard, return 0. 0x22: reserved no-op, return 0. F1/PgUp (0x3B/0x49): tactical overview zoom, return 0. F2/Home (0x3C/0x47): status screen at cursor if char found and not special, return 0. Arrows (0x48/0x50/0x4B/0x4D): play move SFX and move cursor up/down/left/right, return 0.

returns.semantics: Consumed by main: 0 = re-invoke next frame; non-zero = exit main's inner run loop. Only the empty-tile field-command path returns non-zero (it loops the field command menu until non-zero, maps 1->0, returns the remainder unchanged). All other dispatch paths return 0. Ghidra decompiles the function as void and drops the EAX return values (visible in asm as MOV EAX,EBX / XOR EAX,EAX).

comment_original_issue: The src comment was accurate but the return-semantics parenthetical '(0 mapped to non-zero / 1 mapped to 0)' was imprecise/confusing: there is no '0 mapped to non-zero' mapping; the field-command path loops until the menu returns non-zero, then maps only 1->0 and returns any other non-zero value unchanged.
notes: Single caller is main @ 0x25BF4 (call site 0x25DCE): game_loop_result = fd2_game_main_loop(); the inner do/while loops while ==0 and 'if (game_loop_result == 0xffffffff) exit_outer_loop = 1', confirming the int return is genuinely consumed (matches src/plate). Function body (lines 162-300) and src comment match the decompilation exactly. Ghidra plate is already detailed, accurate, and consistent with src (it already states the field-command path is the only non-zero-returning path), so plate left unchanged. Name kept: descriptive, no address residue.
